inspection.visualResult: All ten cropped brand strings and logos remain sourced literal pixels; no lettering clipped; no people/interiors retained. ARTCENT is the least resolved and retains raised-letter occlusion/shadows; not suitable for fine-detail transcription. All output planes are rectangular; their metric aspect is estimated, not surveyed.

notExtracted.reason: May sign is oblique and upper-left physical panel boundary exits image; no safe complete panel quad. Existing 2025 fascia retained as explicitly historical; May photo confirms presence but not unchanged appearance.
Distant small fascia and exit sign overlaps right-hand panel; existing higher-resolution 2025 crop retained explicitly historical. No occlusion painted out.
Interior poster/glass decal, not facade sign. Photo05 supplies fascia; no invented interior extracted.
Lettering is behind glass with reflections, low resolution and intersecting frames, not an isolated fascia plane; no clean facade texture fabricated.

unresolved.issue: Source is oblique; rectification cannot reconstruct hidden sides of raised lettering or lost pixel detail.

No EXIF intrinsics or physical sign measurements. Common-focal aspect estimate is traceable and sensitivity recorded, but exact metric aspect/lens undistortion remains unverified; preserve PNG aspect, do not stretch to entire shop width.
